scope: Original fictional single-kettle, paid in-person sale in England and Wales. Arithmetic dates are illustrations, not assertions about applicable law on those dates.

branches.facts: New domestic kettle from a trader; single paid sale in a shop; s9 nonconformity at delivery stipulated; all trigger conditions complete 1 October; clear rejection communicated 31 October.
branches.reviewQuestion: Does this fully stipulated case support the proposed short-term route, subject to the uncompleted legal snapshot review?
branches.proposedFeedback: The calendar is at its last counted day. Entitlement still depends on the stipulated facts and approved statutory scope.

branches.facts: Same delivery and stipulated defect; communication moved to 1 November; no extension agreement or repair request.
branches.reviewQuestion: Does feedback correctly end only the modelled short-term window, while leaving other remedies unassessed?
branches.proposedFeedback: This is after the unextended calendar window; no conclusion about all other remedies follows.

branches.facts: Payment receipt 1 October; delivery note 5 October; ownership-transfer date not given.
branches.reviewQuestion: Is there enough evidence to determine when every trigger condition was met?
branches.proposedFeedback: A purchase date alone does not establish all clock conditions. Obtain the missing transfer fact.

branches.facts: A video shows malfunction on 10 October; cause and condition at delivery disputed.
branches.reviewQuestion: Does the case avoid extending s19(14) to the short-term route or making the recording prove every issue?
branches.proposedFeedback: The stipulated recording shows that event, not its cause or the delivery condition.

branches.facts: A scratch was specifically disclosed before sale; an unrelated electrical fault is alleged.
branches.reviewQuestion: Are the disclosed condition and separate alleged fault kept distinct?
branches.proposedFeedback: Identify which defect was disclosed and which allegation still needs evidence.

branches.facts: Kettle functions as described; buyer changes preferred colour after an in-person sale.
branches.reviewQuestion: Does the scoped quality case avoid inventing a fault or denying any separately promised returns policy?
branches.proposedFeedback: A changed preference is not the stipulated quality defect; any separate policy is outside this model.

branches.facts: Buyer asks whether the shop can repair the kettle; no clear rejection statement is stipulated.
branches.reviewQuestion: Are communication meaning and any repair request assessed instead of inferred from contact alone?
branches.proposedFeedback: The record does not establish a clear rejection; repair-request interpretation needs separate review.

branches.facts: Trader agrees to refund on 31 October; return collection is discussed separately.
branches.reviewQuestion: Are the refund-agreement clock, promptness and return arrangements distinguished?
branches.proposedFeedback: The separate illustrative fourteen-day calendar ends 13 November; that outer date does not displace the duty to avoid undue delay.

branches.facts: Goods have not yet been delivered; a clear rejection is proposed.
branches.reviewQuestion: Does the calendar avoid treating a not-yet-started counting window as a blanket bar under s22(5)?
branches.proposedFeedback: Before the counting start is not automatically too early to exercise a right; the substantive route needs review.

branches.facts: Repair agreed; returned item may still be nonconforming.
branches.reviewQuestion: Keep outside first-case arithmetic until waiting-period start/end and returned-goods conditions receive complete review.
branches.proposedFeedback: Repair waiting periods require a separate reviewed case; no unextended deadline is returned.

outsideFirstCase: final rejection, deductions, litigation or limitation advice
